description: gleam_rules.ml detect_ignored_result (~line 288) collects ALL applications in a function body (collect_apps) and reports the first one whose name resolves in Type_inference.lookup_gleam as Result-returning. It does not check whether the call result is actually scrutinized by a case expression or bound and handled — so any function that calls int.parse/dict.get/etc. anywhere, even with correct case handling, is flagged 'Use case expression to handle both Ok and Error'. Likely a major false-positive source. Fix options: only flag when the EApp appears in a context whose value is dropped (non-final statement position, ELet PDiscard already covered by detect_discard_result — consider merging the two rules). Add fixture tests for handled vs unhandled cases.
title: detect_ignored_result: flags Result calls even when handled
